comment: Golden-hash parity vectors for the data_vault shape hash construction.
hash_expression is what macros/data_vault.sql renders dpf_vault_hash as for the duckdb
adapter, through the shipped dpf_hash_hex duckdb arm and the shipped dpf_type mapping.
basis is written in declaration order, which is the hash input order: this construction
does not sort, upper-case or trim, so two relations agree on a key only by naming the
same columns in the same order. expected_hash pins what DuckDB computes for each vector,
so a changed sentinel, separator, case rule or dispatch arm moves at least one row and
fails on execution. Every stored hub, link and satellite row in a live estate is keyed by
this construction, so a silent change would orphan all of them.
hash_expression: upper(md5(concat_ws('||', coalesce(cast(full_name as TEXT), '^^'), coalesce(cast(postcode as TEXT), '^^'), coalesce(cast(loyalty_points as TEXT), '^^'), coalesce(cast(as_of_date as TEXT), '^^'))))
